scope: Repository-local declared scenario evidence, not exhaustive invariant conformance. Uncovered means no reviewed test binding is declared here, not that no relevant test exists.
verification_limit: The checker verifies definition IDs and named test declarations, not whether a test semantically establishes an invariant. It does not execute tests, prove reachability or physical safety, or evaluate the rationale.
source_limit: IDs come from local vendored documents. cell_operations/v1.0/05_validation_audit.md is outside the four normative-document hashes and can drift independently between repositories.

invariants.reason: Platform half only: P's committed intent precedes its Prepare and Authorize emission. The Host SEND_ENTERED journal commit before the native write belongs to the Host in rx-solutions and is not observed here.

tests.name: intent_commit_precedes_every_emission_and_an_unentered_send_is_refused
tests.reason: After an injected T1 rollback no Prepare or Authorize is pending; the retry queues exactly one Prepare naming the committed operation and its Issued permit. SEND_ENTERED for the not-yet-entered Prepare is refused and the work stays NotSent. An Authorize appears only after the Prepared receipt, and SEND_ENTERED on it consumes the permit.

invariants.reason: Platform request identity and immutable-operation scenarios; not every API or transport.

tests.name: changed_intent_under_same_key_is_a_conflict
tests.reason: Reuses an admitted key with a changed execution timeout and asserts KeyConflict.

tests.name: same_slot_new_key_and_lost_reply_do_not_create_another_operation
tests.reason: Injects a committed-but-lost reply, retries the key and the same slot with a new key, and asserts the same operation ID and one consumed budget unit.

invariants.reason: Platform delivery uncertainty; native retransmission prevention is a separate Host/driver boundary.

tests.name: an_entered_send_with_no_remote_receipt_remains_unknown_and_is_not_reissued
tests.reason: After RemoteNotFound, delivery planning reports first_emission=false and preserves Unknown, no outcome and Quarantined.

invariants.reason: Platform conclusion under a native completion rule in a simulated cell. Driver-side timeout handling and BT internals are not exercised.

tests.name: succeeded_comes_only_from_rule_evidence_not_timeout_idle_or_executor_claims
tests.reason: A ResultCaptured receipt, the executor's part-completion claim (ConditionUnknown), a GOOD idle fact, the clock passing the execution timeout with its watchdog invalidation, and a native return with a status schema the rule does not name each leave outcome None with no evidence. Only the rule's status record settles Succeeded, with exactly that evidence.

tests.name: native_receipt_capture_does_not_stand_in_for_completion_policy
tests.reason: Under an Unobservable completion rule, a receipt plus correlated native evidence leave outcome None and phase Reconciling.

invariants.reason: Conflicting controller reservations across two simulated cells; not proof of physical controller exclusion.

tests.name: one_physical_resource_is_reserved_across_cells_not_per_cell_alias
tests.reason: Reserves one controller from cell A and asserts Busy when cell B submits work using the same resource.

invariants.reason: Not platform-local. Control samples are never relayed through platform RPC (contracts 02 section 6); session_id/source_seq replay rejection and session closure after restart or expiry are enforced by the Host in rx-solutions. P refuses CONTROL_SESSION admission (engine/executor_requests.rs, engine/reconciliation.rs), so no platform test can observe sample replay.
One native-evidence T2 commit under an injected pre-commit rollback and a committed-but-lost reply. Other decision commits (checkpoint, release, observation batch) are not asserted by this binding.

tests.name: t2_fault_leaves_no_partial_decision_and_the_retry_records_the_bundle_once
tests.reason: A rolled-back commit leaves the operation, including its revision, unchanged and the native evidence unreadable. After the retry, for both faults, the revision rose by exactly one, Succeeded names exactly the native and condition evidence, and the store holds one evidence, slot and cursor row, one outcome-bearing control change equal to the stored work, and one applied audit event.

invariants.reason: Terminal success and release prerequisites at domain and platform boundaries.

tests.name: terminal_success_does_not_release_and_conflicting_result_is_preserved
tests.reason: Successful conclusion remains Held; absent support handover rejects release, and contradictory results quarantine without rewriting success.

tests.name: resource_release_requires_all_current_handover_facts
tests.reason: After completion, false, missing, stale or wrong-generation handover observations reject release and preserve Held.

invariants.reason: Platform Host-read ingestion, diagnostics and evidence-journal continuity. Host boot detection and silent device reboots are Host/device-side. Observation facts carry no sample sequence, so observation gaps are bounded by age expiry. The in-process direct fact-report path, which no ingress reaches, is not covered.

tests.name: host_read_delay_unorderable_time_and_excess_uncertainty_never_present_a_fresh_sample
tests.reason: Freshness is measured from acquisition: a read delivered at the age limit passes, and one tick later is AgeExceeded, Unknown and refused at start. A foreign clock, a capture after P's now or excess uncertainty is refused with no fact stored and diagnostics reporting a missing, unusable source.

tests.name: observation_generation_loss_is_latched_once_and_does_not_adopt_the_new_source
tests.reason: A changed source generation is reported GenerationChanged, the stored fact is not GOOD and the run is RecoveryRequired; a repeat report does not latch again.

tests.name: host_read_ingestion_checks_context_and_preserves_the_native_source_fields
tests.reason: A Host read carrying a different Host boot, or a future acquisition, is refused and no fact is stored; a delayed read keeps its native acquisition time.

tests.name: operator_diagnostics_share_the_condition_evaluator_and_do_not_change_authority
tests.reason: Past the maximum age with no new sample, diagnostics report AgeExceeded, an unusable source and Unknown while retaining the last value.

tests.name: evidence_gap_is_not_skipped_and_conflicting_sequence_is_quarantined
tests.reason: A native-evidence batch starting after a sequence gap is refused and the contiguous batch is accepted; a conflicting body for an accepted sequence leaves the operation Disputed and Quarantined.

invariants.reason: Installed configuration alone does not commission a cell; no physical site qualification is established.

tests.name: uncommissioned_cell_cannot_start_from_package_presence
tests.reason: Creates a run from installed configuration without qualification and asserts StartRun is rejected as NotCommissioned.

invariants.reason: Part completion is the consumer tested. The UI path is represented only by an operator identity refused at the engine API; HTTP routes and BT internals are not exercised.

tests.name: part_completion_follows_the_conclusion_ledger_not_receipts_executor_or_operator
tests.reason: After a ResultCaptured native-return receipt the outcome is None. Executor part completion is refused ConditionUnknown and the operator's attempt Forbidden, with the run still Executing. After the ledger concludes Succeeded from evidence, completion still waits for release, then confirms the part and completes the run.

invariants.reason: Not platform-local. Predetermined protective reactions run in the Host and device-control path (rx-solutions profiles, controller or PLC protective functions). P has no protective-reaction path; its injected commit failures only roll back platform authority writes, which bears only on the clause that the exception authorizes no normal command.

Platform admission (T1) only. Dependency coverage is verified when qualification is registered and at restart, and configuration apply clears qualification; admission does not re-verify dependencies itself. The Host final gate is rx-solutions.

tests.name: admitted_permit_binds_current_qualification_envelope_and_scope_vector
tests.reason: Intents whose site, profile or calibration digests differ from the qualified step are refused CapabilityMissing and write no work. The admitted permit binds the current qualification ID and revision, an envelope equal to the qualification's and the run's, and the cell's epoch vector. A hold voids it and revokes the mandate bound to the same vector.

invariants.reason: Condition-evaluator UNKNOWN propagation and strict condition syntax; not all application condition bindings.

tests.name: three_valued_groups_and_invalid_hidden_branch
tests.reason: Asserts UNKNOWN is retained in required ALL/ANY combinations and an invalid hidden branch is rejected rather than ignored.

tests.name: quality_alone_never_proves_freshness_generation_or_unit
tests.reason: GOOD-valued input with an unbounded age, wrong generation/unit/clock, future sample, excess uncertainty or dispute evaluates UNKNOWN.

tests.name: condition_schema_is_closed
tests.reason: Adds an unsupported skip field to a condition document and asserts decoding fails instead of silently ignoring it.

invariants.reason: Platform admission for PRODUCTION and SETUP. The platform has no RECOVERY purpose, so no recovery write can be admitted; the Host final gate is rx-solutions.

tests.name: admission_binds_permit_purpose_and_rejects_a_parent_of_the_other_purpose
tests.reason: SETUP refuses parts and a part-bearing submit, and admits a partless operation with a Setup permit that consumes one operation unit. PRODUCTION refuses an activation without a part and a submit with no part or a foreign part, and admits only one naming the run's own part with a Production permit. Refused requests write no work.

invariants.reason: Maintained-condition recovery cannot revive a revoked run; normal transient-wait clearing is outside this declaration.

tests.name: maintained_condition_recovery_does_not_revive_an_old_mandate
tests.reason: Reports a maintained fact false then true and asserts the run remains RecoveryRequired with its ConditionLost block.

invariants.reason: Partial Arm acknowledgement is not a production mandate; access clearance is a separate boundary.

tests.name: start_requires_all_hosts_and_cannot_be_completed_by_partial_ack
tests.reason: Acknowledges only one of two Hosts and asserts the attempt stays Arming, the run Prepared and mandate absent.

invariants.reason: P's permit record and emission gate. The Host's native gate and its own consumption journal are rx-solutions. P never assigns the Expired state, so expiry is enforced by time at emission.

tests.name: permit_binds_operation_content_host_epoch_and_purpose_and_is_not_emitted_after_consumption_or_expiry
tests.reason: The permit names the operation, intent digest, Host and boot, cell epoch vector, mandate and Production purpose. Another Host cannot plan its delivery, and a foreign or altered-digest receipt is refused. Once SEND_ENTERED consumes it, its queued Authorize is refused StaleEpoch and stays New. Another operation's Authorize is refused after its permit expires. A hold voids the unconsumed permit and its Authorize.

invariants.reason: P's T1 resource check (CO13 steps 1-4) when both intents name the common support resource. The platform has no MaterialState or alias model, so undeclared aliases are not detected (cell operations 01 section 6); maintained-support validation belongs to mechanics, profiles and local protection.

tests.name: reciprocal_support_pass_does_not_admit_two_releases_of_one_common_support_resource
tests.reason: Each release requires the other device's support PASS. A second release naming the same support resource on another Host is refused Busy after its conditions are evaluated, leaving one work, one permit and no partial reservation; with distinct support resources both are admitted.

invariants.reason: P's half does not hold. A case's affected-cell closure is fixed when it opens (engine/intervention.rs); a cell installed later on a shared resource starts with no blocks or open cases (engine/configuration.rs), qualify does not check related cases, and start admission checks only the cell's own blocks and cases (engine/admission.rs ready). The case restart path is not implemented (READY_FOR_RESTART is never assigned). Host restart gating is rx-solutions; personnel and external restrictions are site procedures.

P's records for case acknowledgement, procedure reports, requalification and start. Physical reset, HMI acknowledgement and Host restart behavior are outside. The case restart path is not implemented, so no case leads to a start.

tests.name: acknowledgement_work_completion_and_reset_observation_never_become_a_start
tests.reason: Acknowledging a case leaves it CONTAINMENT_PENDING and the cell byte-identical. Finished work leaves it PROCEDURE_ACTIVE, and personnel and handover only reach REVALIDATING with the cell restricted. The old run is refused MandateRevoked and a new one QualificationRequired. A reset observation returns the case to containment, clears the personnel and handover records and latches a new epoch.

tests.name: qualification_activation_is_atomic_clears_only_owned_blocks_and_requires_separate_start
tests.reason: Activation clears the owned blocks without creating a run in any cell; a separate CreateRun and StartRun only reaches Arming.

invariants.reason: Reviewed process-change preparation and apply, configuration dispatch, and non-operating-close clearance. Reported device or tool changes are not asserted; Host fence application belongs to rx-solutions.

tests.name: a_prepared_change_voids_prior_authority_and_waits_for_the_new_epoch_fence
tests.reason: Preparation advances the cell and every scope epoch, sets RevalidationRequired and latches a ConfigurationChange block. The run loses its executor, the unsent permit is Voided, its work NotExecuted and the mandate Revoked. Every Host gets a fence with the new vector, and HostFenceUnconfirmed persists until the exact acknowledgement, refusing one labelled with the old epoch.

tests.name: configuration_apply_is_atomic_and_lost_reply_recovers_selection_epoch_and_history
tests.reason: Apply records and clears the previous qualification, sets RevalidationRequired, advances the epoch by one and adds a ConfigurationChange block; the change is applied but not activation-authorized and lists RequalificationRequired.

tests.name: configuration_dispatch_requires_fences_terminal_and_retains_one_task_after_commit_loss
tests.reason: Host configuration dispatch is refused HostNotPrepared until the preparation fences are acknowledged.

tests.name: non_operating_close_rechecks_time_case_epoch_evidence_and_current_actor
tests.reason: After a clearance is prepared, a hold, new condition evidence, a false or new-generation fact, or a new shared-scope cell each makes the close fail, leaving the case open with no out-of-service block.

invariants.reason: The backup-rollback clause does not meet its specification. Restore rotates the store generation, and the next start raises each epoch by one (engine/invalidation.rs) without comparing Host maxima; cell operations 04 section 6 and CO22 require a new epoch above P and related Host maxima. invariant_authority_tests.rs p_restart_and_backup_rollback_leave_no_old_mandate_or_permit_executable shows that P restart and restore revoke P's own mandates, permits and sessions. Host, executor and controller restarts are not bound here.

Not platform-local. Actual safety-function performance is established only by OEM, functional-safety and site validation. P makes no such claim: its stop report sets physical_shutdown_assessed to false (engine/lifecycle.rs). The absence of such a claim in UI or other consumers is not testable here.

Not platform-local. Control-stream sessions, epochs, sequences and native application order are enforced by the Host's single consumer and command gate in rx-solutions (contracts 02 section 6). P carries no control stream and refuses CONTROL_SESSION admission; its own sequence checks cover evidence journals and receipts only.

Not platform-local. Protective reactions under DB, communication or condition failure belong to Host and device local protection and site validation. A platform storage failure only blocks new admission and dispatch and exercises no protective reaction.
Budget unit separation, repeated work within one part and restoration; not every executor topology.

tests.name: setup_and_material_budgets_are_not_interchangeable
tests.reason: Rejects operation consumption in a part budget and part consumption in an operation-count budget.

tests.name: last_counted_part_can_continue_but_a_new_part_cannot_be_created
tests.reason: Repeatedly references the already-counted part without another decrement, while rejecting creation of a new part after exhaustion.

tests.name: restoring_run_budget_never_refunds_consumption
tests.reason: Serializes and restores a consumed part budget, retains remaining=1, rejects duplicate consumption and eventually rejects another new part.

invariants.reason: Software configuration presence versus cell commissioning; documentary approval alone is not validated here.

tests.name: uncommissioned_cell_cannot_start_from_package_presence
tests.reason: An installed, unqualified cell may create a run but StartRun returns NotCommissioned.

invariants.reason: P's half does not hold under backup rollback: after a restore P fences at its restored epoch plus one (engine/invalidation.rs) instead of above the Host maxima that cell operations 04 section 6 and CO22 (tagged OI11 and OI17) require. Without a restore, invariant_change_tests.rs platform_epochs_only_advance_and_stale_arm_or_fence_replies_clear_nothing shows P's epochs only advance and stale Arm or Fence acknowledgements clear nothing. The Host's own epoch map is rx-solutions.

Not platform-local as a whole. P queues a fence per Host at invalidation and reports HostFenceUnconfirmed until an acknowledgement matches the current epoch vector (engine/lifecycle.rs, engine/process_change.rs). That exposes part of the interval but neither bounds it nor allocates physical reactions, which belong to Host application in rx-solutions and validated local protective functions.
